title: New Officers Elected for 2026
author: Yash W.
content: Congratulations to our newly elected officers! Yash W. as President, along with dedicated Vice Presidents and team members. Together, we will make 2026 an amazing year for Hindu YUVA!

title: Spring Semester Events Announced
author: Club President
content: Mark your calendars! We have an exciting lineup of events planned for the spring semester. From cultural celebrations to community service projects, there's something for everyone!

title: Community Service Day Success
author: Volunteer Lead
content: Thank you to all 50+ volunteers who participated in our community service day! Together we made a real difference in our local community. Photos from the event are now available in our gallery!
